main_text.p: Causalis, ut γὰρ enim, ἐπειδὴ quoniam, ὅτι quód, διότι & καὶ ὅτι propterea quód, ἕνεκα quapropter, ἵνα ut, ὅπως quó, ὄφελ idem poetis.
Rationalis, ut ἄρα quare, οὖν igitur.
main_text.head: PETRI RAMI PROFESSORIS REGII GRAMMATICÆ GRÆCÆ Liber tertius, de Convenientia.
Cap. 1. De apostropho.
main_text.p: PRIMA convenientia vocum, est in apostropho, cúm separatæ voces apostrophum nesciant.

page.notes: The Greek words are printed with accents and breathings; some are doubtful in the scan (ὄφελ, ἐπειδὴ, ἄρα). The chapter opens with a large woodcut initial P, joined to "RIMA". The title block lines are rendered as a single head; the printed line breaks are not preserved.
